text:
rachael: Quick ask — can someone run onboarding perf for cesium-7b q4_0 on p4d? Need latency/throughput + memory numbers for seq=512 and seq=2048. Baseline is last week's mixtral run. Want to publish a short perf table to docs by EOD Thurs. Thanks!

mike: I can run it. Which dataset/prompts? Should we use the standard perf harness (bench/throughput.py) with batch_sizes [1,4,8]? Also which ckpt (v1 or v1.1)?

rachael: use v1.1, prompts = perf_open_prompts_2k.json in s3://redwood-bench/prompts/. Use tokenized length distribution like production (mostly ~200-600). Include cold start latency and steady-state (30s warm).

mike: On it. Running on p4d. Command:
```
./bench/run.sh --model cesium-7b-q4_0 --seq 512,2048 --batches 1,4,8 --duration 60 --save s3://redwood-bench/results/cesium-7b/1769936000
```
I'll post results when done.

bench-bot: Job queued: job_id=rb-98543, cluster=p4d-prod, started 1769936065

mike: Results (quick summary): seq=512, batch=4 => 2100 tok/s, p95=38ms, p99=70ms, GPU mem=39GB. seq=2048, batch=1 => 520 tok/s, p95=160ms, p99=260ms, GPU mem=43GB. All runs used KV caching warm path. Full logs: s3://redwood-bench/results/cesium-7b/1769936000/summary.json

simon: Hmm throughput is ~15% lower than mixtral baseline at same config (seq512/batch4). I see a higher kernel launch overhead in flamegraph: https://perf.redwood.internal/fg/rb-98543. Suspect decoder attention memory copies.

anya: Can we re-run with quantized-kernel flag and with large-batch config (batch=16) to test batching headroom? Also please add a small unit in ci to catch regressions >10%.

mike: Re-ran with --quant-kernel and batch=16, seq=512 => 2850 tok/s, p95=44ms, mem=41GB. Uploading. Looks like quant kernel recovers perf but slightly increases p95. S3 link: s3://redwood-bench/results/cesium-7b/1769936000/quant-summary.json

kyle: Filing a ticket ENG-4219 to add cesium-7b to nightly perf suite and track kernel opt. PR for docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/289 (perf table + notes). Assigning to @mike and @simon. :eyes:

rachael: Awesome — can we get the final table (seq512/2048 numbers, note quant vs default) in the PR by EOD? I'll merge if green. Thanks team! :party_parrot:

mike: :thumbsup:
